$comment: Figma Code Connect registry. scripts/generate-code-connect.mjs reads it and writes src/app/components/<module>.figma.ts (v2 parserless templates). scripts/check-code-connect.mjs gates the result (pnpm figma:connect:check, and pnpm test).

templates.<Export>.properties records the Figma component property definitions: name, type, options, default. It also records how each property maps onto the code prop. The code side (props, cva keys, defaultVariants) is always read from source, never copied here.

Node URLs are not stored here. They come from the component JSDoc tag `@figma <node-url>` through public/hds-manifest.json figmaUrl. A template without a URL is generated with a placeholder and reported as unmapped.
TEXT and INSTANCE_SWAP `default` values are preview text for the local renderer only. They are not Figma data.

exempt lists every public cva module (a src/index.ts barrel export whose file calls cva()) that has no template, with the reason. queued = the component exists in Figma but has no template yet. no-figma-component = nothing to map.

evidence.hds#73: Figma component property inventory from the Figma AI audit of file c8MaVgwxOlxm4wr8wnH0Z4 (2026-07-02). UNVERIFIED against the live file. Refresh it with an authenticated property read before publishing.

Button.note: Figma defaults Variant to Primary; code defaults to secondary (open decision, docs/architecture/variant-contract.md). The template emits variant whenever it differs from the code default, so either ruling renders correctly.
